description: Hourly Consumption Electric Mobility is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset presents information on hourly electricity consumption associated with electric mobility (EM) on the public grid, segmented by state, municipality, and district. The records allow for understanding usage patterns, identifying areas of higher demand, planning new charging infrastructure, and evaluating the impact of the growth of electric mobility on the grid. Coverage: Portugal. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy, Electric Mobility. Its keywords are homepage. The portal shows 2025-10-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
